source_description: User-uploaded 8 MiB Pixel Watch 2 DTBO, internal com.android.build.dtbo.fingerprint parsed from binary; only derived facts committed; original IMG remains private.
scope: Six fixed reg properties in /fragment@reserved-memory/__overlay__ of all 11 overlays; overlay alone does NOT establish effective base DTB or bootloader memory ownership.
finding: All six fixed overrides are byte-for-byte identical to the user-supplied CP1A DTBO in every corresponding overlay.
other_cp1a_to_cp2a_changes: All 11 overlays: 15 property changes, 5 added DT nodes, 0 removed DT nodes (comparing parsed FDT nodes and properties).
MCU wake/crash GPIO: added google,gpiochipwake0; GPIO19 mux/config, changed phandle assignment.
Battery google,bms: deleted google,chg-term-voltage and google,chg-term-voltage-debounce overrides.
Removed explicit disabled status from google,gbms_virt_storage overlay; resultant effective status requires base DTB.
node_name_warning: Some IPA/GPU node names retain @547xxxxx, but effective overlay reg values are 0x549xxxxx. Trust reg, not node suffix.
